title: Refill shipment rules of the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A refill on the Urology and Continence Supply Program ships only while the program is active. A program in referral received, pending authorization, on hold or closed receives no refill.

## 1. Authorization drawn

1.1 Each refill draws on one authorization grant of the program, and that grant is recorded on the shipment. The ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.

1.2 The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining.

## 2. Supply days and units

2.1 **Supply days.** The supply days of a shipment are the tier's standard supply per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain. *This clause is no longer in force for a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program; that refill's supply days are set by the current basis for such a refill. For every other refill the clause remains in force.*

2.2 The units and pieces follow from the supply days under the item and quantity rules.

## 3. Refill confirmation

3.1 On tiers where refill confirmation is required, the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand. *This clause is no longer in force for a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program; the current basis for such a refill sets how use is confirmed and how the supply on hand is counted. For every other refill the clause remains in force.*

3.2 The confirmation date is recorded on the shipment. Larkfield never ships those tiers automatically. Larkfield's own refill reminder on those tiers is made no sooner than the tier's reminder lead, in calendar days, before the planned ship date. The confirmation rests on the customer's own statement.

3.3 On the self-pay tier, refills ship on the subscription schedule without a per-shipment confirmation.

## 4. Earliest ship date

The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than the tier's early-ship lead, in calendar days, before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item. The count is in calendar days. The previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply. The earliest permitted ship date is the early-ship lead before that end date. Shipping on that earliest date is allowed. A replacement shipment never counts as the previous refill.

Put another way, the earliest permitted ship date falls the previous refill's supply days less the early-ship lead after the previous refill's ship date.

| Hypothetical previous refill | Supply end | Early-ship lead | Earliest next ship date |
|---|---|---|---|
| shipped day 0, 30 days' supply | day 30 | 7 days | day 23: shipping on day 23 is allowed, on day 22 it is not |
| shipped day 0, 90 days' supply | day 90 | 10 days | day 80: shipping on day 80 is allowed, on day 79 it is not |

## 5. Coverage verification

The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within the tier's coverage re-verification period, in calendar months before the ship date. This is shown by the coverage record's last verified date, and a verification on the boundary day itself counts. The self-pay tier has no coverage to verify.

*Hypothetical:* with a 6-month period and a ship date of 20 August, a last verified date of 20 February is within the period. A last verified date of 19 February is not.

## 6. Shipping charges

- Standard ground shipping is free on insured tiers.
- On the self-pay tier, standard shipping costs the tier's standard shipping fee, posted as a patient charge, unless the shipment's cash-price total reaches the free-shipping threshold.
- Expedited shipping is provided at the customer's request for the expedited shipping fee. It is posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed. It is recorded as expedited at no charge when the expedite only makes up for a delay Larkfield caused.

## 7. Billing route

A refill on a payer tier is billed to the payer by claim, with the ship date as the date of service. A refill on the self-pay tier is charged to the customer at the Larkfield cash price.

## 8. Inpatient stays

On tiers where an inpatient hold is required, nothing ships while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility. The program is held under the hold and closure rules.
